_note: Human-written copy. Each role holds many variants; the engine picks one by hashing the prompt, so a given prompt is stable but two prompts diverge. A variant may be a plain string, or {t, needs:[slots], tone:[registers]} — a guarded variant is only eligible when every slot it names has a value, which is why {city} never renders empty. Hero titles use *word* for the accent colour. Add variants freely; more variants is more variety.
